answer_1.quote: ...we introduce a cascaded translation system that uses pretrained QE metrics to determine whether to defer examples from a smaller model to a larger one... We use the WMT24 test sets, which span multiple domains (news, social, speech, and literary) and 11 language pairs (en-cs, en-de, en-es, en-hi, en-is, en-ja, en-ru, en-uk, en-zh, cs-uk, and ja-zh).

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate systems with METRICX to reduce the risk of "reward hacking" and better reflect real quality improvements (we also provide COMET scores)...

answer_4.quote: ...We recruited professional translators who were native speakers of the target language... using a DA+SQM (direct assessment + scalar quality metric) source contrastive evaluation. Translators were asked to read two alternative translations for each source and evaluate them on a continuous scale from 0 (no overlap in meaning) to 100 (perfect translation)...
answer_4.guideline: Translators rated translations on a continuous scale 0-100 with labeled tick marks (0-6) describing quality levels (6=perfect meaning and grammar, 4=most meaning preserved and few grammar mistakes, 2=some meaning preserved, 0=nonsense).
